business_problem: Avid needed to turn decades of deep-archive media into searchable, monetizable assets without moving huge files around or forcing editors to manually inspect billions of metadata points.
solution_summary: Avid uses Google Cloud to address this challenge: Avid needed to turn decades of deep-archive media into searchable, monetizable assets without moving huge files around or forcing editors to manually inspect billions of metadata points. Cloud Storage Rapid Cache gives autonomous agents millisecond access to media files without costly data migration, serving as the storage layer. BigQuery centralizes billions of metadata points into the context layer that grounds media-intelligence agents, serving as the storage layer. Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform Vision lets editors search and navigate petabytes of raw footage and powers large-scale media processing, serving as the serving layer. Gemini provides the multimodal intelligence behind AI-assisted editing and discovery, serving as the compute layer.

Avid partners with Google Cloud to reduce media discovery from hours to seconds, helping studios monetize decades of archives.
Cloud Storage Rapid Cache provides a caching layer that grants autonomous agents millisecond access to media without triggering costly data migration fees.
BigQuery centralizes billions of metadata points to construct the interconnected context layer that grounds the AI.
Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform Vision and Gemini models allow editors to easily search and navigate petabytes of raw footage.
data_flow: Heavy media files stay in place behind Cloud Storage Rapid Cache, BigQuery centralizes the metadata that describes them, Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform Vision uses that context to search and process footage, and Model Context Protocol links the agents to external systems for multi-step actions.
